The '''yubnut''' was the [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] of the [[Yub tree]] that was native to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] and other planets. [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] enjoyed the fruit.
